Design.evidence_source: [001_uc_santa_barbara] The study employed a between-subject design, randomly assigning participants to either the Full Information or Hidden Information condition.

country.evidence_source: [001_uc_santa_barbara] The experiment was conducted at UC Santa Barbara.

info_cost.evidence_source: [001_uc_santa_barbara] In the Hidden Information condition, participants could reveal the recipient's payoff at no cost.
